inspiration.source_location: BUGS/MDEV-36355.sql:42 (SET-form duplicate-key update with VALUE() in RETURNING)
inspiration.observed_pattern: A duplicate-key SET upsert resets one numeric column to DEFAULT and uses VALUE(column) in a RETURNING expression.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced from the preference refresh to one keyed row and one defaulted numeric column; the new names, values, and schema isolate the incoming-value projection from unrelated columns and rows.

fixture_notes: One existing row is reset from 23 to its default 7; VALUE(amount) + 1 must expose the incoming assignment 99 plus one, yielding 100.
determinism_notes: The fixed primary key, default, incoming value, and single returned row have no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE value_probe (probe_id INT PRIMARY KEY, amount INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 7)

steps.sql: INSERT INTO value_probe SET probe_id = 1, amount = 99 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE amount = DEFAULT RETURNING probe_id, amount, VALUE(amount) + 1 AS incoming_plus_one

checks.sql: SELECT probe_id, amount FROM value_probe ORDER BY probe_id
